verdict.rationale: Sentry's Alerts docs state that alerts take action when issues match pre-defined rules, and can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks or use other integrations (e.g. Slack on new issues). Seer Autofix also automatically scans incoming issues to automate triage and create PRs. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of rule conditions and filters, evidence that rules can be defined programmatically via the API or MCP for AI-native workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
